title: DX11 Stale SRV/UAV Bindings Between Render Graph Passes
description: DX11's immediate context preserves shader resource bindings across draw/dispatch calls. When the render graph executes multiple passes (GBuffer → Shadow → Lighting → Compute), SRV/UAV slots from previous passes leak into subsequent ones. This causes: (1) textures bound as SRV in pass N still bound when pass N+1 tries to use the same resource as RTV/DSV — D3D11 Debug Layer error "Resource still bound on input". (2) Compute dispatches inherit stale SRV bindings from graphics passes — dimension mismatches (TEXTURE2D vs TEXTURECUBE). (3) IBL compute producing black output because stale auto-exposure UAV corrupts irradiance dispatch.
whenToUse: Any DX11 renderer with multiple render passes per frame, especially when using a render graph that manages barriers but doesn't explicitly unbind resources between passes.
whenNotToUse: DX12 and Vulkan handle this via explicit resource barriers and descriptor sets — no stale binding issue.
